core_memory.user_feedback_michael_performance_espres: Michael loves the espresso machine's consistent crema and steam wand for latte art. He appreciates the coffee grinder's impact on flavor and aroma, and the vacuum-sealed canisters help maintain bean freshness in Seattle's humid climate. The digital scale aids in consistent brewing.
core_memory.user_feedback_michael_shipping_delays: Michael reports shipping delays, inconsistent tracking, and one instance of damaged arrival. While support responded quickly and provided a replacement, the experience was stressful and impacted initial satisfaction.
core_memory.user_feedback_michael_order_management: Michael wants a unified order dashboard and proactive emails about shipping delays or backorders(e.g., 'This item may take a week longer to ship'). This would help him plan purchases and reduce uncertainty.
core_memory.user_feedback_michael_customer_service: Michael praises timely, thorough support and the personal touch in resolving queries. He suggests streamlining support so agents can instantly view his full purchase history when switching channels, reducing the need to re-explain details.
core_memory.user_feedback_michael_loyalty_program: Michael loves first-time buyer discounts and proposes a loyalty rewards program with an annual membership. Perks include free shipping, extended warranties, and early access to new products. He sees this as a way to reward repeat customers and deepen brand commitment.
